documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement On Opening Of New Showroom
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations growing by 60% year-on-year to INR 121 crores and EBITDA increasing by 39% year-on-year to INR 18 crores. Management highlighted robust demand in both retail and wholesale segments, supported by active participation in exhibitions and targeted marketing campaigns. The company is actively expanding its retail footprint in Gujarat, with new large and mid-format stores scheduled to open in Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar in Q2 and Q3 FY27. Furthermore, the company is strategically transitioning towards hedging its inventory through Gold Metal Loans to improve capital efficiency and reduce commodity price volatility over the long term. RBZ Jewellers Limited reported an operational revenue of INR 1,208 Mn with an EBITDA margin of 14.9% for Q1FY27.

guidance.claim: The company targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
guidance.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

guidance.claim: Management stated that explicit forward guidance is not being provided for the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: There is no guidance for this year, frankly saying.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates good response and demand for the B2B side for Quarter 2.
demand_outlook.quote: B2B side will go on doing well, I do not see growth constraints, but major leap of growth is still going to happen from retail.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue increased by approximately 60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth during the fourth quarter was supported by festive demand, particularly during the Akshay Tritiya season.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth momentum was supported by festive demand, particularly during Akshay Tritiya season.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: For Q4 FY26, retail revenue grew by 31% year-on-year to INR 121 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of segmental performance for the quarter, retail revenue stood at INR121 crores, registering a healthy growth of 31% year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch the Surat store in Quarter 2 and Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores typically have around 10,000 square feet carpet area while mid format stores have 5,000 square feet carpet area.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Inventory deployment in small format stores is around INR 50 crores plus or minus 10% to 15%.
capex_expansion.quote: While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand retail presence into Surat and Rajkot, with operations targeted to start by Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: RBZ Jewellers is exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of approximately 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The company currently has no plans for capex towards its manufacturing setup.
capex_expansion.quote: And I think right now, we are not looking for any kind of capex in manufacturing setup.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations for the quarter stood at INR 121 crores, registering a 60% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter under review, revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores registering a strong growth of 60% Y-o-Y with a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR 18 crores with EBITDA margins at 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 9 crores, translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Retail revenue for the quarter stood at INR 78 crores, registering a 70% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: In terms of segmental performance for the quarter, retail revenue stood at INR78 crores registering a robust 70% Y-o-Y growth.

margins_costs.claim: Wholesale revenue for the quarter stood at INR 42 crores, reflecting a 47% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: Wholesale revenue stood at 42% reflecting a strong 47% Y-o-Y growth.

margins_costs.claim: Job work revenue for the quarter stood at approximately INR 1.2 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Job work revenue stood at approximately INR1.2 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Full-year FY26 EBITDA rose by 43% to INR 92 crores, with EBITDA margins expanding by 233 basis points to 14.44%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins are around 12% to 14% for retail, 7% to 8% for wholesale, and 6% to 8% for B2B.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, retail would be around 12% or 14% GP. Wholesale will be around 7% to 8% GP. B2B will be around 6% to 7% and 8% GP.

orders_capacity.claim: Total factory capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: Factory production consumption is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1,000 kgs, utilizing the factory at around 50% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current manufacturing capacity utilization is approximately 50% to 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, RBZ Jewellers launched 730 new designs, averaging 8 designs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio

capital_allocation.claim: By the end of the financial year, the debt-to-equity ratio will still be below 1:1, estimated around 0.8 debt to 1 equity.
capital_allocation.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has already started using Gold Metal Loans (GML) in the current quarter and plans to progressively churn over the entire inventory to be hedged over a period of three years.
capital_allocation.quote: We have already started using GML in this quarter, a little bit, but as and when the quarter passes we want to completely churn over the whole inventory to go hedged. But that will take three year of time that I, as you have said.

capital_allocation.claim: Management prefers to keep debt-to-equity levels around 1:1, with potential leverage extending to 1.4 or 1.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We want to stay -- we want to keep the debt levels at 1:1 ratio ideally or 1:1 point, maybe leverage to 1.4, 1.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The company intends to explore Gold Metal Loans (GML) in FY27 to fund gold purchases for upcoming store openings.
capital_allocation.quote: So we will be exploring GML in this financial year perhaps for buying -- the new buying of gold that will happen for the upcoming stores

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that average gold rates remained stagnant, resulting in negligible inventory gains in the system for Quarter 1.
risks_headwinds.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that recent regulatory restrictions on import and custom duty announcements are not advantageous, but their full ground-level impact is still being evaluated.
risks_headwinds.quote: Certainly, I think these restrictions are not advantageous, but up to what level there is an impact is crucial.

management_commitments.claim: Capex break-even for the new stores will be achieved in a year or less.
management_commitments.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

management_commitments.claim: The B2B to B2C revenue mix is targeted to become 50-50 in a year or two.
management_commitments.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

management_commitments.claim: In the long term, the B2B to B2C revenue mix will become 75-25, with 75% coming from retail.
management_commitments.quote: and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

management_commitments.claim: By the end of the fiscal year, at least 20% of corporate sales mix will be of 18 caratage.
management_commitments.quote: I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

management_commitments.claim: The company targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: RBZ Jewellers targets to commence operations at both Surat and Rajkot showrooms by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to open the third and fourth showrooms within the current calendar year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
